diagnosis: Senile cataract, right eye - phacoemulsification with IOL
reasonText: Cataract surgery is covered under your policy only after a specific waiting period of 24 months of continuous cover. Your cover began on 05/03/2024, so on the date of admission (22/07/2025) you had completed 16 months and 17 days. The waiting period for cataract ends on 04/03/2026. The claim is therefore not payable at this time.
